summary: Headlights, tail lights and low-beam cones of simulated trams and trains, reusing Phase F1 (cars, trucks, buses). No new dataset: every lighting value is an estimate taken over from F1; vehicle positions come from the simulation.

inputs.name: Tram and train poses
inputs.source: norrkoping-simulator-backend simulation (SSE snapshot, one pose per section), smoothed per frame by src/lib/publicTransport.ts; the beam uses the leading section (section 0)
inputs.accuracy: simulated traffic; not real vehicles or timetables

inputs.name: Lamp positions on the tram and train models
inputs.source: the drawn models in src/lib/publicTransport.ts: white lenses at the front end of the leading section, red lenses at the rear end of the last section (geometry unchanged by F2)
inputs.acquired: read from the code 2026-11-13; checked against the model geometry by src/lib/lighting/railLights.test.ts

tram.from: centre of the leading 6.12 m module

train.from: centre of the leading 19.5 m car

inputs.accuracy: matches the drawn lenses (the unit test compares them); the models are generic drawings, not surveyed vehicles

estimates.name: Beam (intensity, shape, reach, colour)
estimates.value: the Phase F1 values unchanged: BEAM_CANDELA 30000 cd, BEAM_SHAPE, BEAM_RANGE_M 60 m, BEAM_COLOR (1, 0.95, 0.86)
estimates.basis: a generic road-vehicle dipped beam (docs/vehicle-lights-f1/vehicle-lights-provenance.json). No photometry of Norrköping's trams or of the X61 train was used; real rail headlamps differ (a train's main beam reaches much further)
estimates.label: estimate

estimates.name: Lens glow
estimates.unit: emissive intensity added at full night (day values unchanged: 0.5 / 0.3)
estimates.basis: the Phase F1 values; visual tuning, not photometry
estimates.label: perceptual calibration

estimates.name: Lamp arrangement
estimates.value: two white lenses in front, two red lenses behind, as the models were drawn before F2
estimates.basis: the existing generic models. The real front signal of the vehicles (for example a third, upper headlamp) was not researched and is not drawn
estimates.label: estimate

estimates.name: Selection
estimates.basis: the Phase F1 budget, now shared by cars, trucks, buses, trams and trains
estimates.label: rendering budget

switching: Lights follow the street-lighting night level env.artificial, as in Phase F1. By day nothing is lit (lenses as before, no beam); real trams and trains run with headlamps on by day too.
coordinates: Scene units, x east, z south, 25 m per unit × grid scale factor 0.9996584126, origin E 569030 / N 6494989 (EPSG:3006, SCENE_REFERENCE); heights are RH2000 / 25 (rail top from src/lib/trackProfile.ts). Heading 0 points along +z (scene south); forward = (sin h, cos h). The lamp is placed along the leading section's pitch (nose-up positive); the beam direction stays horizontal.
